findings.passage: Defend voting rights and safeguard fair and free elections. Every American deserves an equal voice in our democracy, free from voter suppression, gerrymandering, or interference. I’ll work to restore trust in our electoral system and ensure every vote is counted.
findings.note: Campaign website text as quoted verbatim by Ballotpedia (dated Feb 17, 2026). General statement on voting rights and election trust. It does not mention ID or citizenship documents.

findings.passage: Hold accountable anyone who threatens America’s elections. Free and fair elections are the foundation of our democracy. I’ll make sure anyone attempting to interfere is brought to justice.
findings.note: Campaign website text as quoted verbatim by Ballotpedia. Pledge on prosecuting election interference. No mention of ID or citizenship proof.
